transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello. ... Well, I suppose I'm here because of... some issues at work. 

I... I keep hearing people talking about me. Mostly the board members, or my staff. I'll hear them through the conference room walls, or... even from my phone when it's completely turned off. They keep saying I'm ruining the company. It just... it sounds so clear that I actually answer them out loud. And then I look around and realize... no one else heard it. 

So... yes. That's why I'm here.
Aside from hearing these voices, have you been experiencing any significant changes in your mood, such as feeling extremely low or unusually high and energetic?
No. I... I haven't noticed anything like that. My mood is fine. I'm just... trying to do my job, really. It's just the... the things I'm hearing.
Are you convinced that these people are actually conspiring against you, or do you have any other unusual beliefs about what is happening to you?
I... I don't know about conspiring. I just hear what I hear. They say I'm ruining the company, so... that's what they think. I don't... I don't know what else to tell you about it.
Have you ever had any head injuries, seizures, or been diagnosed with any neurological conditions?
No. I haven't. Nothing like that. My health is... it's fine.
Do you ever find that your thoughts feel disorganized, or that it is difficult to keep your mind on one topic when you are speaking?
No, I... I can keep my mind on things just fine. My thoughts are my own. I just... I do my work. That's all.
Have you noticed any other changes in your daily life, such as losing interest in activities you used to enjoy, or finding it harder to take care of your personal hygiene or social obligations?

I don't know... I guess things are different. I used to... I used to drive every idea. I'd call people after openings. Now... I just sit at my desk. Sometimes for hours, just staring at the agenda. I don't really talk to my staff much anymore... or my husband. I just... I don't feel anything about the work I used to love. It's just... different.
Have you noticed if your speech or your reactions to others have become noticeably silly, inappropriate, or difficult for other people to follow?

I wouldn't call it silly. But... I suppose people look at me differently. 

Sometimes during board meetings... or at gallery events... I just... I'll stand up. I don't always know why. I just start moving the pens around on the table, or... or the name cards. Putting them into patterns. Or I'll... I'll just repeat a phrase someone just said. 

Sometimes I catch myself just holding my hands up in the air... like I'm presenting something to the room. I know afterward that it... it didn't make any sense to anyone there. But... I don't really want to dwell on that.
When you catch yourself moving those items into patterns or repeating phrases, are you doing it because the voices are instructing you to, or does it happen for some other reason?

No... not voices. I just... I don't know why. 

I just do it. There isn't really a reason.
